instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct spelling of the word.

atoms.b: The ((++women woman wimen wymen)) shared a cup of tea.
atoms.finishSound: The women shared a cup of tea.

atoms.b: How should we ((++decide deside diside desyde))?
That cake’s not big ((++enough enuff enouf enugh)) for everyone.

atoms.b: The woman is climbing at ((++height hite heitht hyght)).

atoms.finishSound: There’s a floating island in the sky!
